_help: The 'Now' card on the hub. If 'slides' has entries, the card is a rotating banner (one slide per project, pips to switch, auto-cycles). Otherwise 'building'/'playing' show as before; a blank title hides an entry. url is optional. art: anyps | wizard | ramses | realms | none.

building.title: Ramses
building.note: My own AI assistant that runs on your PC. Version 1.0.1 is out; next up are longer overnight jobs, tidier tool output and a fully offline model of its own.

slides.title: Ramses
slides.note: Take back control of AI: an assistant that lives on your own PC and keeps your data with you. Version 1.0.1 is out now. Next up: longer overnight jobs, tidier tool output, a clear status while it works, and a fully offline model of its own.

slides.title: AnyPS native cores
slides.note: The from-scratch rebuild now runs PSP homebrew natively, and retail PSP games are next. The PS2 core has its own graphics renderer in place and is getting faster to boot. Both land in a future AnyPS release.

slides.title: AndersCraft: Mastery
slides.note: The next big step for the realms: Mastery, with 100 levels across 20 tracks and 80 perks, plus quest XP and gold that scale with your level. Meanwhile AndersCraft Studio 0.9, the free editor behind it all, is out for other server owners.
